basic_info.description: Your new residence on Yerba Buena Island - San Francisco's newest neighborhood is pleased to present this spacious two-bed, two-bath home. Its thoughtful floor plan features a powder room, a spa-styled primary bathroom with a Carrara marble with a freestanding soaking tub, & a wine fridge. The outdoor terrace is perched above a garden courtyard & Magnolia tree. Additional interior features include a kitchen appointed with Arclinea cabinetry & Miele appliances, white oak flooring, floor-to-ceiling windows, 9'-10'5''ceilings in the living/bedroom. Residents will have access to unprecedented amenities, including The Island Club, a ~10,000 SF clubhouse with fitness studio & wellness programming, outdoor pool, spa & fireplace, private dining room; staffed front desks, 24/7 roving security patrol; resident app with a host of services, shuttle to/from the ferry. All images/views are representative.
